dict.string: Pitwall reads your projects on the Desktop to show what your agents changed. Agents you start in Pitwall also work in these folders.
Pitwall reads your projects in Documents to show what your agents changed. Agents you start in Pitwall also work in these folders.
Pitwall reads your projects in Downloads to show what your agents changed. Agents you start in Pitwall also work in these folders.
Pitwall reads your projects on external drives to show what your agents changed. Agents you start in Pitwall also work there.
Pitwall reads your projects on network drives to show what your agents changed. Agents you start in Pitwall also work there.
